race.comment: DIDDLE DUMPLING (4) was forced to work hard off a wide draw in a tougher race at Randwick nearly 6 weeks ago, and she was not knocked around late when finishing near the rear. She cops another wide gate, but does drop in class, so give her another chance. METALLIC CAT (6) is a very progressive but lightly tried 5YO mare who just went down by a nose fresh up here a fortnight ago when trying to make all the running. She gets a big swing in her draw this time, drops 2kg, and can go one better. SCILLATO (9) has been hard to catch, and will drop 5.5kg here. She was unsuited to leading last time out, and is worth one more chance with a return to her usual get-back style of racing. Keep safe. I AM ADONIS (12) only weakened late fresh up off the top as the Favourite last time out, and he is capable of taking them all the way this time. ANDALE ANDALE (10) strips fitter second up, and will have the pole position. Include.
